questions.stem:

(I) An equipotential surface through a point is normal to the electric field at that point.

(II) When a dielectric is placed in an external electric field, the electric field inside the dielectric is less than that outside it.

(III) The potential difference between the plates of a charged parallel plate capacitor decreases when its plates are brought closer.

questions._flag: Taxonomy: this 5-mark question spans four subtopics of Electrostatic Potential and Capacitance — (i)(I) Equipotential Surfaces, (i)(II) Electrostatics of Conductors and Dielectrics, (i)(III) Capacitors, Capacitance and their Combinations, (ii) Potential Energy of a System of Charges. Filed on the last, which is the only quantitative part (2 of the 5 marks) and the single largest block; no one subtopic dominates.
